The genuine inverted potential is physically qualitatively different from purely attractive/on-off traps because stationary moments may diverge; the exact double OU-like covariance with infinite fourth moments quantifies a substantial limitation of second-order spectroscopy. Not simply a numerical instance, and the full classification includes all admissible parameters and critical boundary.
